purpose: Round-31 F15 captured-source assertions for S048 (Microsoft Security Vulnerability Research, https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/msrc/msvr), the new lane row for the vendor third-party-finding coordination theme. The SHA-256 pin binds the committed local capture; assertions quote the page text exactly. Normalization: capture-source.py's html_to_text() output is compared under source-recheck.py normalize() (markup tags such as <u>...</u> stripped, all whitespace collapsed to single spaces), so a quote may span a wrapped line; every quote below was measured exactly-once under that normalization before it was written here, so no assertion carries an anchor. Quirk: snapshot line 2 ("This is the Trace Id: <32 hex>") is a per-request identifier and is never quoted; the pin therefore binds these committed bytes, not a refetch.

quotes.quote: MSVR learns about vulnerabilities in third-party products in three ways
quotes.location: L31; the three-route intake sentence that heads the list of routes (routes follow on L32-L34).

quotes.quote: These vulnerabilities are reported to the MSVR team, which then works with the affected vendor to fix the issue.
quotes.location: L32; route 1, internal Microsoft engineers finding third-party software flaws.

quotes.quote: These issues are coordinated by MSVR.
quotes.location: L33; route 2, external researcher reports to the MSRC that affect a third-party product or both parties — the statement that third-party findings are coordinated by MSVR.

quotes.quote: Any issues are reported to the affected vendor under accepted Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure practices.
quotes.location: L34; route 3, Microsoft's own research projects on non-Microsoft products.

quotes.quote: as a vendor affected by vulnerabilities in its products and services
quotes.location: L35; role 1 of three — Microsoft as the affected vendor.

quotes.quote: as a finder of new vulnerabilities in third-party products and services
quotes.location: L35; role 2 of three — Microsoft as a finder in third-party products.

quotes.quote: as a coordinator of vulnerabilities that affect multiple vendors
quotes.location: L35; role 3 of three — Microsoft as coordinator across vendors.

quotes.quote: This coordination takes place under Microsoft's Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure (CVD) approach.
quotes.location: L35; the CVD framing sentence that introduces the three roles (ASCII apostrophe; L30 uses the curly form and is not quoted here).
